status: frozen replay protocol before actual energy calculations
objective: Replicate the published GatedDeltaNet online-memory update as a conditional quadratic equilibrium in the actual frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, and connect its implicit response equation to recorded steering responses.

primary_source.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
primary_source.authors: Songlin Yang, Jan Kautz, Ali Hatamizadeh
primary_source.reference: Section3.1, equation10 and online-learning formulation; matrix orientation is transposed to match the pinned implementation

model_source: Pinned transformers5.19.0 Qwen3_5 torch_recurrent_gated_delta_rule, actual checkpoint revision2fc06364715b967f1860aea9cf38778875588b17. Original FP32 promoted effective parameters, reference kernels, frozen/eval weights.

equations.quadratic_equilibrium_condition: Optional algebraically equivalent regression/proximal objective: when beta*c<1, lambda=beta/(1-beta*c)>=0 and Pi_prox(S)=||S-B||_F^2/2+lambda*||S^T*k-v||^2/2 has the same unique minimizer S_new. This norm-aware reformulation is our derivation of the published update, not the exact Table1 objective and not a unique energy representation.
equations.finite_element_form: Optional proximal form: K_prox*S_new=f_prox, K_prox=I+lambda*k*k^T, f_prox=B+lambda*k*v^T. Distinguish this instantaneous minimizer from the fixed-driver steady-state potential.
equations.virtual_work: For any virtual matrix displacement D, <D,K*S_new>=<D,f>
equations.implicit_response: For the optional proximal equilibrium, K_prox*dS=df_prox-dK_prox*S. Do not apply steady-state stationarity to a transient native update.
equations.stiffness_eigenvalues: 1 in key-orthogonal directions; 1/(1-beta*c) along the current key. These are conditional memory-state stiffnesses, not a full-transformer spectrum.
equations.published_step_objective: Pi_paper(S)=||S-B||_F^2/2-beta*<S^T*k, v-B^T*k>; its unique minimizer is the native one-step update. This is Table1 in transposed/half-scaled notation.
equations.fixed_driver_potential: Psi(S)=<S,K_ss*S>/2-<f_ss,S>. The native update is one unit gradient step on Psi with the current input drivers frozen. It generally is not the steady-state minimum after one step.
equations.steady_state: K_ss*S_equilibrium=f_ss when a steady equilibrium exists. K_ss eigenvalues are1-gamma and1-gamma+gamma*beta*c. Record gamma=1 degeneracies instead of claiming uniqueness.
equations.discrete_work_balance: For DeltaS=S_new-S_previous, W_external=<f_ss,DeltaS>, DeltaU=<K_ss*S_previous,DeltaS>+<DeltaS,K_ss*DeltaS>/2, D=||DeltaS||_F^2-<DeltaS,K_ss*DeltaS>/2. Native force balance implies W_external=DeltaU+D; D>=0 when eigenvalues(K_ss)<=2. These are mathematical, dimensionless model quantities, not physical heat.
equations.moving_landscape: At token2, Psi2(S2)-Psi1(S1)=[Psi2(S1)-Psi1(S1)]+[Psi2(S2)-Psi2(S1)]. Fix the explicit zero-at-S=0 gauge; the first term is a changed-input landscape term, the second is local relaxation.
equations.dynamic_response: dS_new=(I-K_ss)*dS_previous+df_ss-dK_ss*S_previous. Compare this stable form to archived native q.

normalization: Use the actual l2norm eps1e-6 and measured c; do not silently replace c with1. Report every beta*c>=1, non-finite or poorly resolved case. The positive-quadratic minimizer claim is conditional; explicit gradient-step loss contraction additionally holds for0<=beta*c<=2.

parents.calibration_bridge: Fully preserved study14 original calibration IDs r14_cal_window, r14_cal_labels, normal first-token records, immutable incoming caches and9 recorded affected recurrent layers. Validate parameter/conv/norm reconstruction before wider panel.
parents.main_panel: All6 phase17 questions, two normal steps and all80 signed target rows, all18 recurrent layers and16 heads. Use phase17 only after its full raw backup is verified.
parents.derivative_panel: Primary6questions and reference2questions at both token positions:16 context/direction/position cases,18 recurrent layers,16 heads; compare implicit response to archived native first derivatives. No new whole-backbone forwards.

parameter_fidelity: Read the effective parameters produced by the exact pinned original model loader and BF16-to-FP32 promotion, including A_log's effective values. Loading the model is counted setup; no model forward or weight training. Export the small needed parameter subset and release the loaded model before local replays.
local_reconstruction: Recover keys/values from the recorded post-update convolution window with the original convolution and SiLU. Recover beta/gamma from the recorded residual input, original zero-centered RMSNorm and in_proj_b/in_proj_a/A_log/dt_bias. Replay the original recurrent update from the recorded incoming state. Do not infer drivers from S_new or fit parameters to the desired output.

checks.primal_replay: Every full recurrent field error<=1e-6 times max(1,native norm), including old calibration bridge.
checks.equilibrium: Every eligible head stationarity error<=1e-5 times max(1,load norm). Retain and report ineligible heads; never clamp lambda or drop failures.
checks.virtual_work: Four fixed Gaussian virtual displacements per head, seed20261015; error<=1e-5 times max(1,absolute internal/external virtual work).
checks.loss_contraction: Compare the predicted factor and actual regression loss with explicit FP32 resolution floors; also report unresolved tiny losses.
checks.implicit_response: Compare K*dS=df-dK*S against archived native q, separately reporting transported history, new input driving and stiffness changes. Preserve conditioning/cancellation failures.
checks.native_force_work_energy: Check every native transient update against f_ss-K_ss*S_previous, the fixed-driver potential decrement and discrete work/dissipation balance, with explicit FP32 roundoff bounds. This is the primary energy/dynamics replication; retain all degenerate optional proximal cases.

interpretation: Replicate the paper online-learning objective and native update first. Then verify independently derived fixed-driver gradient-flow/work balance and an optional norm-aware proximal reformulation. Energies are conditional and non-unique; do not claim a global residual-stream potential, physical conservation, semantic label, unknown-steering detector or that one ordinary update is already at its fixed-driver steady equilibrium.
preservation: Keep all original phase15/16 failures and phase17's quadratic comparator failure and report-saving fault. Preserve all head/case failures, full input recipes, effective parameter hashes and derived drivers. Do not duplicate whole parent datasets unnecessarily; preserve exact parent references and reproducible derived arrays.
derivative_stability: Retain direct differentiated rank-one update as a stable algebraic evaluation of the implicit response. Report both rounded-native-state and reconstructed-equilibrium force residuals, conditioning and cancellation; do not change criteria or drop poorly conditioned heads.

replay_numeric_rules.work_bound: Cauchy bound ||measured_force_residual||*||DeltaS|| plus100*float64_epsilon*max(1,absolute work/energy), absolute1e-10 comparison slack
replay_numeric_rules.virtual_displacements: One fixed4direction unit-Frobenius Gaussian set for each layer/head, reused across cases; no selecting favorable probes.
